# gitmoap_repository_mr_settings (Data Source)

Get effective MR settings for a repository (resolved with group inheritance). The merge-request settings in force for the repository: merge method, squashing, deleting the source branch, what blocks a merge, and how stacks behave. Unless the repository overrides its groups, they come from the nearest group that sets each one; anything set nowhere takes its default. Anyone who can see the repository may read them.

The token needs `mr_settings:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_mr_settings" "api" {
  repo_id = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Read-Only

- `allow_merge_without_pipeline` (Boolean) While `require_pipeline_success` is on: whether a merge request that no pipeline applies to
— none is defined, or none matched its branch, paths or actions — may merge. Off by
default, which blocks it.
- `block_on_rejection` (Boolean)
- `delete_source_branch_default` (Boolean)
- `merge_method` (String)
- `override_group_settings` (Boolean)
- `require_issue_criteria_green` (Boolean)
- `require_linked_issue` (Boolean)
- `require_pipeline_success` (Boolean) Block the merge until every pipeline that applies to the merge request's head has
succeeded. Off by default.
- `squash_option` (String)
- `stack_auto_retarget` (Boolean)
- `stack_enforce_merge_order` (Boolean)
- `stack_restack_strategy` (String)
- `unresolved_threads` (Boolean)
